name: The Burrows
beachAccess: About a 10-minute walk to Freshwater East beach
confirmedFeatures: Cooked breakfast, vegetarian and vegan options, underfloor-heated en suites, garden, picnic lunches on request
overview: The Burrows is a four-room B&B in Upper Portclew House, a Georgian house about ten minutes' walk from Freshwater East beach. Rooms have en suites with underfloor heating and breakfast is cooked to order.
surfTripFit: Dog-friendly and within walking distance of the beach, with a big breakfast before a session.
